info.title: Merchant API Documentation
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Merchant Dashboard endpoints.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT authentication. Include the token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your_jwt_token>
```

## Services Overview
- **Main API (Backend)**: Core merchant operations, orders, dashboard
- **Pricing Service**: Bundles, tiers, domestic/international pricing
- **Identity Service**: OAuth authentication, users, roles

tags.description:
Endpoints for managing domestic and international pricing.
These endpoints interact with the external pricing microservice to retrieve and manage pricing data based on bundles, tiers, zones, and couriers.
Pricing is calculated based on pickup zone, drop-off zone, weight, COD amount, and payment method.

**⚠️ Important: Tenant Header Required**
All requests to the Pricing Service (`https://pricing-service.sideup.co/api` or `https://pricing-service.sideup.org/api`) 
MUST include the `x-tenant` header with value `eg` (Egypt) or `sa` (Saudi Arabia).

Example:
```
x-tenant: eg
```

get.description:
Retrieves domestic pricing for a specific merchant based on their tier and any custom pricing configurations.
This endpoint calls the external pricing microservice at `/api/get-domestic-prices/{merchant_id}`.

**Pricing Factors:**
- Pickup zone (from_zone)
- Drop-off zone (to_zone) - if 0, returns all zone combinations
- Weight
- COD amount
- Payment method

Results are grouped by courier and include delivery fees, tier pricing IDs, and totals.

parameters.name: to_zone
parameters.description: Drop-off zone ID (destination zone). Use 0 to get all zone combinations.

get.description:
Retrieves and compares domestic shipping prices across all couriers for a specific tier.

**Note:** This endpoint currently only works for Saudi Arabia (SA) tenant.
Returns pricing data from the `DomesticPrice` model with courier, pickup zone, and drop-off zone relationships.

**Use Cases:**
- Price comparison tool for merchants
- Courier selection assistance
- Pricing analysis

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Tier level to compare prices for

get.description:
Retrieves pricing data for all tiers based on zone combinations.
This endpoint calls the external pricing microservice at `/api/tiers/pricing/v2`.

**Features:**
- Returns pricing for all available tiers
- Supports filtering by pickup zone (from_zone)
- If to_zone is 0, returns all zone combinations
- Can return JSON (for AJAX) or render HTML view

**Dependencies:**
- Uses `ZoneV2` lookup to get available zones
- Fetches tier data from `Tier` model

parameters.name: from_zone
parameters.description: Pickup zone ID. Defaults to first available zone if not provided.

parameters.name: to_zone
parameters.description: Drop-off zone ID. Use 0 to get all zone combinations.

post.description:
Sets custom pricing for a specific merchant, overriding the default tier pricing.
This endpoint calls the external pricing microservice at `/api/custom/pricing/v2`.

**Customizable Fields:**
- Basic delivery price
- Extra weight fees (per kg)
- COD processing fees
- Maximum COD amount
- Supplies/packaging fees
- Return shipment fees
- Pickup fees

**Note:** Custom pricing is linked to a specific tier_pricing_id and optionally a bundle_pricing_id.

post.description:
Retrieves international shipping rates for a specific destination.
Prices are calculated based on destination country, state, city, postal code, and package weight.

**Weight Limit:** Maximum 30kg. Orders exceeding this limit require contacting account manager.

**Note:** This endpoint is part of the main backend API, NOT the pricing-service microservice.

**Supported Couriers:**
- Aramex
- DHL
- UPS
- FedEx

country_code.description: Alternative field for country code (ISO 2-letter code)

200 (Weight Limit Exceeded).description: Weight exceeds limit - contact account manager

message.example: Very special offer kindly contact your account manager.

get.summary: Get domestic prices by merchant ID (Pricing Service)
get.description:
Retrieves domestic shipping prices for a specific merchant from the pricing microservice.
Prices are calculated based on the merchant's tier, custom pricing overrides, and zone combinations.

**⚠️ Requires `x-tenant` header: `eg` or `sa`**

**Parameters used for pricing calculation:**
- from_zone (required): Pickup zone ID
- to_zone (required): Drop-off zone ID  
- weight (optional): Package weight (rounded up to nearest integer)
- cod (optional): Cash on delivery amount
- payment_method (optional): Payment type (COD, BANK_CARD, ONLINE, PREPAID)

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: Package weight in kg (will be rounded up)
